title: ImageAnalysisTask
description: Message contract for food-image analysis tasks published by nutri-business and consumed by nutri-agent via RabbitMQ.

taskId.description: Globally unique identifier for this analysis task.

userId.description: The user who uploaded the meal image.

imageUrl.description: Pre-signed URL to download the original image from OSS/MinIO.

ossKey.description: Object key within the OSS bucket (used for referencing without re-signing).

mealType.description: Meal category of the uploaded image.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the task was created.

userContext.description: Optional snapshot of user preferences and health goals passed at publish time.

healthGoal.description: Primary health objective of the user.

dailyCalorieTarget.description: Target daily calorie intake in kcal.

callbackRoutingKey.description: Optional RabbitMQ routing key for the result to be returned to nutri-business.
